text:
You need a developer who can drop into your existing Cloud9 AWS environment, build the backend for a chat module, and connect it to OpenAI API so responses appear in your current UI.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, and OpenAI API integrations. In my recent Call centre speech analytics project for Vantor Call Centers, I built a pipeline that transcribes calls, separates agent and customer, and writes a QA summary for every call. That system processed 2,300 hours of audio, achieved a word error rate of 11.8%, and increased QA coverage from 3% to 100% of calls.

I can help you implement the chat backend, wire it into your existing front-end view, and build the response function that sequences replies from OpenAI API within your AWS setup.
